tickets.name: D-03 [Major] A listening agent on a zero-point routine can never finish - stuck "listening" forever
tickets.notes:
Area: Agent lifecycle / RoutineFocus.countTaskCompleted · Found: day 1 · Priority: P1

REPRO
Preconditions: A routine item whose stimulus points are 0 (card shows e.g. "Geniuses +0"), with an agent that has both a start and an end event.
1. Focus the 0-point routine (deck). 2. Tap the ring -> START AGENT. 3. Wait for the start event to return 200 and the stage to become `listening`. 4. Complete every item on that routine's checklist (header reaches "2 of 2 done"). 5. Wait; reload; reopen the app on later days.

EXPECTED
With every checklist item done the end event fires, the agent reaches `finished` and the result is shown.

The end event never fires. agentStage stays `listening`, the top bar keeps a permanent `hearing` badge, /agents keeps reporting "1 live now", and the agent cannot be run again. Still `listening` 5 simulated days and 5 browser sessions later.

At 2 of 2 done: vm.countTaskTotal(task) = 1 but vm.countTaskCompleted(task) = 0, with task.points = 0 and K.earned = 0. apps/web-app/src/pages/RoutineFocus.vue countTaskCompleted(): `if (!total || !k || !task.points) return 0;` - a 0-point routine short-circuits to 0 and can never reach total, so maybeFireAgentEndEvent's `completed < total` guard never clears. Cross-check on a second routine: on Wind-down (points 5) completing one checklist item moved K.earned 2.5 -> 3.333 and the slot counter 3 -> 4, so the mechanism works whenever points > 0.

Starting an agent on a routine item with points = 0 and then completing all of that routine's day goal items fires the end event and the agent reaches `finished` (or the UI refuses to start an agent on a 0-point routine and says why). No agent is left in `listening` with every item complete.

tickets.title: Week-goal progress contradicts the server's own progress in the same response - completed days shown as missed, then "Done" declared two criteria early
tickets.name: D-02 [Major] Week-goal progress contradicts the server's own progress in the same response - completed days shown as missed, then "Done" declared two criteria early
tickets.notes:
Area: Cascade panel (routineFocusModel.buildCascade) vs goalCompletionCriteria.buildMilestoneDays / autoCheckTaskPeriod · Found: day 5 · Priority: P1

REPRO
Preconditions: A week goal with milestones spread across the week; at least one day where the milestone is complete but another linked day goal on that date is not.
1. Complete the Sunday and Monday milestones of a week goal on their own days, leaving one other linked day goal open on each. 2. On Thursday open /home -> period-tab-week and scroll the card to the top. 3. Compare the counter and the day dots with the GoalItem's own `progress` / `milestonesComplete` fields. 4. Open /home/classic and compare the Week Goal Streak widget.

EXPECTED
One number for one goal. The counter, the day dots and the rule text agree with the rule the server actually applies.

ACTUAL
Cascade: "1 / 5 days · Active", Sun 4 = cancel (missed), Mon 5 = cancel, Tue 6 = check. Server, same cache entry, same payload: progress 3, milestonesTotal 15, milestonesComplete 7. /home/classic's Week Goal Streak repeats the cascade's version (Su cancel, Mo cancel, Tu check). Two days later the cascade read "5 / 5 days", statusLabel "Done", complete true, while the server still had isComplete null, progress 6 and 13 of 15 criteria met with two open.

EVIDENCE
Apollo cache GoalItem:6ac28b450f5ccb1f4455adc4 -> {progress: 3, milestonesTotal: 15, milestonesComplete: 7, milestoneDays: [04-10 missed, 05-10 missed, 06-10 complete, 07-10 missed, ...]} while vm.cascade -> {done: 1, threshold: 5}. The milestone items "Scope Freeze and Sprint Roadmap" (04-10) and "Core Routine Feature Refinement" (05-10) both have goalRef = that week item and isComplete true. Root cause: routineFocusModel.buildCascade does `const done = units.filter(u => u.state === 'done').length` and `complete = !!item.isComplete || done >= limit`, where units come from buildMilestoneDays, which marks a date complete only when EVERY criterion on it is complete; autoCheckTaskPeriod's progress counts ANY one complete criterion per child document; and the real gate, evaluateAutoComplete, is `met >= threshold && outstanding.length === 0`. The card's rule text "Week auto-ticks after 5 day goals" describes none of them.
Screenshot: C:/Users/grvpa/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/D--Documents-Projects-family-routine/ada490d7-ccbc-40e2-921e-6b447730d776/scratchpad/d5-02-week-cascade.png, d6-02-week-claims-done.png

DONE WHEN
With a week goal where day A has a completed milestone and an incomplete sibling day goal, the cascade counter, the day dots, /home/classic's streak widget and the GoalItem's milestonesComplete/progress all tell the same story, the card never shows statusLabel "Done" while the server's isComplete is false, and the rule line states the rule evaluateAutoComplete actually applies.
